nodes.label: CLAUDE.md — repo canon: layout (v3 = HERB eval harness), session entry via state docs, the graphify navigation graph + refresh rule, the hard rules, and the artefact arm built natively in v3/artefact/.

Repo layout: v3/ is the work — a lean self-contained HERB evaluation harness (three arms artefact/lucene/vector, scored with RAGAS); root canon plus gitignored docs/ state/handoff complete the picture.

Session entry point: two live state-doc threads in docs/state/ — the artefact tag-facet design (2026-06-25-artefact-tag-facets-vs-routing) and the eval harness (2026-06-25 vector/RAGAS); newest by date is the entry, read first.
The graphify navigation graph (graphify-out/graph.json) covers v3/ plus the in-repo state/handoff docs and root canon, wired by bridge edges; query it FIRST before grepping.

After changing files run python refresh_graph.py (repo root) — the ONLY rebuild path; never graphify --update (drops external-doc bridges); a printed worklist means a doc needs model extraction before the change is done.
Hard rule design-before-build: no pipeline code until the relevant stage's design is explicitly signed off by the user; present decided-vs-open and get the sign-off.
Hard rule no historical/defensive comments: code, docs and commits state only the present as if written correctly the first time; remove the mistake, write the correct version plainly.
Hard rule docs-track-reality: when a decision closes, update the design doc and memory in the same pass by removal of dead content (not banners); dated state/handoff docs are frozen.
Hard rule critical-review: after writing or changing v3/ code, run /critical-review on the changed files before reporting; skip only for trivial non-logic edits.

The artefact arm is rebuilt natively in v3/artefact/: deterministic stages (scan/probe/derive_corpus/resolver_prototype) exist and are tested, with the HERB mapping key and DESIGN.md/MODEL_CONTRACTS.md alongside; the chunk → tag → facet-retrieval graph is the unbuilt part.

Artefact design canon: the graph spine is closed canon Source → File → Chunk → Tag (the only nodes), hard fields are chunk attributes, and the graph is references into untouched raw source, never copies.
Artefact design canon: the model emits no numbers ever (tagger and interpreter); the chunk description is dead and tags are per-chunk contextual phrases.

herb-eval (Neo4j) is the prior artefact build under the superseded design — a contrast/forensic baseline only, not adopted; the v3 artefact rebuilds from raw natively, and herb is never queried (oracle-contaminated).
